extracted.name: Air Fryer Roasted Sweet Potatoes
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to cook roasted sweet potatoes for an especially fast and delicious way. They come out very crispy and taste delicious.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
instruction_lines: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) as directed by air fryer manufacturer.

Place sweet potato chunks in a mixing bowl. Drizzle melted butter over sweet potatoes and stir to coat. Add salt, cayenne pepper, ginger, and sugar or any combination of these spices; stir to combine. Place sweet potatoes in the air fryer in a single layer.
Air-fry for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring or shaking sweet potatoes halfway through the air frying time. Serve warm.
